findings: db_session_factory rollback asymmetry (confirmed) — db_session_factory uses begin_nested() instead of connection-level transaction with savepoint mode. Restart tests using this fixture may not roll back committed changes. Refactor to use the same connection-level pattern as db_session.

Environment guard does not check permissions (likely) — _verify_database_environment checks database name but not the connected user's role or permissions. A misconfigured connection with elevated permissions would pass the guard. Add a permission check or document that the guard only prevents wrong-database mistakes, not privilege escalation.

Verification script handoff relies on output parsing (possible) — The external verification script expects workflow_id and DATABASE_URL as command-line arguments. The test prints the ID to stdout, but the handoff mechanism (pytest runner parsing output, or manual copy-paste) is not specified. If the output is not captured or passed incorrectly, the verification will test the wrong ID or fail. Document the expected handoff or integrate the verification into the test itself.
